steps.clue: Play one game of Samantha Says on the four computers outside the Receiving Area.
In the Laboratories, hack a red button, then hack four green terminals within sixty seconds.
Shoot the Vril Sphere from the satellite dish with the Wonder Weapon and guide it to the pyramid.
Fill the raised MPD canister with zombie souls, then pull the switch to reveal Samantha.
Fill all four MPD canisters, then insert the charged Vril Device into the pyramid.
Replay Samantha Says three times, then throw a Gersh Device at the Vril Sphere to destroy Earth.
